title: PhantomNoDamage
description: Make the Phantom unable to take damage
body:
这个插件只做一件事：移除了幻翼对玩家造成的伤害和击退效果 使幻翼成为纯粹的观赏生物

This plugin completely removes damage and knockback caused by Phantoms. Turn Phantoms into purely decorative creatures.

这个插件只有5行代码，文件体积非常小

This plugin only 5 lines of code and the file size is very small.
